tools.name: zkgov-stats
tools.description: Get ZKGov platform statistics: total proposals, registered members, and group ID. All data read directly from the ZKVoting smart contract on HashKey Chain testnet.

tools.name: zkgov-proposal
tools.description: Get full details of a governance proposal by ID, including title, description, creator, vote tallies, quorum, timing, and status. Reads directly from the ZKVoting contract.

tools.name: zkgov-list-proposals
tools.description: List all governance proposals with their current vote tallies and status. Returns a summary of every proposal on-chain.

tools.name: zkgov-check-voter
tools.description: Check if a wallet address is registered as a voter in ZKGov. Returns registration status and Semaphore identity commitment.

tools.name: zkgov-members
tools.description: Get the total number of registered voters and the current Merkle tree root of the Semaphore group. Useful for verifying group state.

tools.name: zkgov-activity
tools.description: Get recent on-chain governance activity: proposals created, votes cast, and voter registrations. Parsed from contract events with transaction hashes and explorer links.

tools.name: zkgov-wallet
tools.description: Show the agent's wallet info: address, HSK balance, and voter registration status. On first call, auto-generates a new wallet stored at ~/.zkgov/config.json.

tools.name: zkgov-register
tools.description: Register the agent's wallet as a voter on ZKGov. Creates a Semaphore identity from the wallet private key and submits it on-chain. Returns tx hash.

tools.name: zkgov-create-proposal
tools.description: Create a new governance proposal on ZKGov. The agent's wallet pays gas and becomes the creator. Returns tx hash and the new proposal ID.

votingPeriodSeconds.description: Voting period in seconds (min 1h, max 30d, default 48h)

tools.name: zkgov-vote
tools.description: Cast an anonymous ZK-verified vote on a proposal. Generates a Groth16 proof locally (~3-5 seconds) and submits it. The vote is unlinkable to the wallet address. Requires the wallet to already be registered.

proposalId.description: The proposal ID to vote on

tools.name: zkgov-finalize
tools.description: Finalize a proposal after its voting period has ended. Anyone can call this. Records the final outcome on-chain. Returns tx hash.
